scope: Read-only exact input-case intersection following the actual historical state converter; no public gold labels, predictions, model execution, score adjustment, or extra content hashes.

initial_non_equivalent_whole_state_looku.reason: Historical xLAM state is a JSON object with request and available_tools; comparing the entire serialized state with a plain public query misses the request field.

actual_xlam_converter.labels_origin: annotated answer function names; unchosen candidates were treated as non-positive in the historical converter

what_is_established: Actually selected project fine-tuning inputs exposed the exact normalized wording of these public ToolRet queries.
The historical best24.91 and four-rank bridge24.67 share this ancestor training pool; they cannot be presented as certified unexposed public-ranking baselines.
A zero whole-state comparison was a representation mismatch, not negative evidence of exposure.
what_is_not_established: Candidate catalog, tool-schema, label or full original case equality has not been exhaustively compared.
Some queries may be generic or repeated; the count alone is not proof of benchmark gaming or that the whole Public Index is inflated.
Which matched requests entered ToolRet's scoreable-query subset, and their exact score contribution, have not been quantified.
No adjusted clean score or absence of other legacy overlaps is claimed.
